pairs: Woe to the crown of arrogance,
qui erant in vertice vallis pinguissimæ,
to those who were at the top of the very fat valley,
Ecce validus et fortis Dominus sicut impetus grandinis;
Behold, the Lord is powerful and steadfast, like a storm of hail,
sicut impetus aquarum multarum inundantium et emissarum super terram spatiosam.
like the force of many waters, inundating, sent forth over a spacious land.
Pedibus conculcabitur corona superbiæ ebriorum Ephraim.
The arrogant crown of the inebriated of Ephraim will be trampled underfoot.
Et erit flos decidens gloriæ exsultationis ejus,
And the falling flower, the glory of his exultation,
qui est super verticem vallis pinguium,
who is at the summit of the fat valley,
will be like a premature fruit before the ripeness of autumn,
as soon he takes it in his hand,
In die illa erit Dominus exercituum corona gloriæ,
et sertum exsultationis residuo populi sui;
the Lord of hosts will be the crown of glory and the wreath of exultation for the remnant of his people.
et spiritus judicii sedenti super judicium,
And he will be the spirit of judgment for those who sit in judgment,
et fortitudo revertentibus de bello ad portam.
and the strength of those who return from war to the gates.
Verum hi quoque præ vino nescierunt,
these also have been ignorant due to wine,
and they have gone astray due to inebriation.
The priest and the prophet have been ignorant because of inebriation.
They have been absorbed by wine.
They have not known the One who sees.
They have been ignorant of judgment.
Omnes enim mensæ repletæ sunt vomitu sordiumque,
For all the tables have been filled with vomit and filth,
ita ut non esset ultra locus.
so much so that there was no place left.
To whom will he teach knowledge?
And to whom will he grant an understanding of what is heard?
To those who have been weaned from the milk,
who have been pulled away from the breasts.
For with the speech of lips and with a different language,
et lingua altera loquetur ad populum istum.
he will speak to this people.
Cui dixit: Hæc est requies mea,
He said to them: “This is my rest.
et hoc est meum refrigerium: et noluerunt audire.
“This is my refreshment.” And yet they were unwilling to listen.
Et erit eis verbum Domini: Manda,
And so, the word of the Lord to them will be:
so that they may go forward and fall backward,
et conterantur, et illaqueentur, et capiantur.
and so that they may be broken and ensnared and captured.
listen to the word of the Lord,
who lord it over my people who are at Jerusalem.
and we formed a pact with Hell.
When the inundating scourge passes through,
non veniet super nos quia posuimus mendacium spem nostram,
it will not overwhelm us. For we have placed our hope in lies,
and we are protected by what is false.”
For this reason, thus says the Lord God:
Ecce ego mittam in fundamentis Sion lapidem,
Behold, I will set a stone within the foundations of Zion,
which has been established in the foundation:
whoever trusts in him need not hurry.
And I will establish judgment in weights,
And a hailstorm will overturn hope in what is false;
and waters will inundate its protection.
Et delebitur fœdus vestrum cum morte,
And your deal with death will be abolished,
et pactum vestrum cum inferno non stabit:
and your pact with Hell will not stand.
When the inundating scourge passes through,
you will be trampled down by it.
Whenever it passes through, it will take you away.
quoniam in mane diluculo pertransibit in die et in nocte;
For, at first light of morning, it will pass through,
et tantummodo sola vexatio intellectum dabit auditui.
in the day and in the night, and vexation alone will make you understand what you hear.
For the bed has been narrowed,
so much so that one alone would fall out,
et pallium breve utrumque operire non potest.
and the short blanket is not able to cover two.
Sicut enim in monte divisionum stabit Dominus;
For the Lord will stand, just as at the mountain of divisions.
sicut in valle quæ est in Gabaon irascetur,
He will be angry, just as in the valley which is in Gibeon,
ut faciat opus suum, alienum opus ejus:
so that he may accomplish his work, his strange work,
so that he may complete his work,
peregrinum est opus ejus ab eo.
his work which is foreign even to him.
And now, do not be willing to mock,
lest your chains be tightened. For I have heard, from the Lord,
consummationem enim et abbreviationem audivi a Domino Deo exercituum, super universam terram.
the God of hosts, about the consummation and the abridgement concerning the entire earth.
Numquid tota die arabit arans ut serat?
after plowing all day so that he may sow,
instead cut open and hoe his soil?
Will he not, when he has made the surface level,
For he will be instructed in judgment;
Non enim in serris triturabitur gith,
For coriander cannot be threshed with a saw,
nec rota plaustri super cyminum circuibit;
and a cartwheel cannot revolve over cumin. Instead,
coriander is shaken out with a stick,
But grain for bread must be crushed.
verum non in perpetuum triturans triturabit illum,
Truly, the thresher cannot thresh it unceasingly,
and the cartwheel can neither disrupt it,
nor break it with its surface.
Et hoc a Domino Deo exercituum exivit,
And this has gone forth from the Lord,
so that he may accomplish his miraculous plan and magnify justice.
